memberships_grant_chk.name: memberships_grant_chk
memberships_grant_chk.value: ("memberships"."grant_type" = 'payment' and "memberships"."transaction_id" is not null) or ("memberships"."grant_type" = 'admin_grant' and "memberships"."grant_reason" is not null and "memberships"."granted_by_admin" is not null)

support_plans_duration_chk.name: support_plans_duration_chk
support_plans_duration_chk.value: ("support_plans"."is_lifetime" = true and "support_plans"."duration_days" is null) or ("support_plans"."is_lifetime" = false and "support_plans"."duration_days" > 0)
